# `aitbc prometheus metric`

Read ONE named metric straight from a node's own /metrics endpoint. This is the raw exposition the service exposes right now — not what Prometheus last scraped — so a counter bumped since the last scrape (or reset by a restart) reads truthfully. Exact name match only: ``foo_total`` never returns ``foo_total_bucket``.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc prometheus metric [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Exact metric name — ONE metric per call, no prefix match |
| `--url` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:9009/metrics` | no | Metrics exposition URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:9009/metrics; loopback only unless --allow-remote) <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--label` | text (multiple) | — | no | Keep only samples carrying this label pair (repeatable) |
| `--allow-remote` | flag | `false` | no | Permit a non-loopback --url (the node's own endpoint is the intended source; MCP tools never set this) |
| `--timeout` | integer | `10` | no | Request timeout in seconds |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc prometheus metric --name <metric_name>
```
